# LuxeMia

> LuxeMia is an online Indian ethnic-wear store offering lehengas, sarees, salwar kameez, menswear and jewelry for delivery to United States addresses.

## Store information

- Website: https://luxemia.shop
- Customer support: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, USA
- WhatsApp: +1-215-341-9990
- Email: hello@luxemia.shop
- Shipping destination: United States only
- U.S. standard shipping: $12 USD below $150 USD; free at $150 USD and above
- International shipping: not currently available
- Fit options vary by product and may include semi-stitched, ready-to-wear and made-to-measure

## Important policy information

- Dispatch and transit times depend on the product and tailoring option.
- Sales are final to the extent permitted by applicable law; mandatory consumer rights are not limited.
- Taxes collected by LuxeMia, if applicable, are calculated at checkout.
- For genuine shipping damage, an incorrect item, or a missing item, contact LuxeMia within 48 hours of delivery with clear photos and a continuous unboxing/opening video showing the unopened package, shipping label, and item condition.
- Product availability, price, size and delivery information on the product page and at checkout take priority over summaries in guides.

## Editorial policy

LuxeMia articles are published by the LuxeMia Editorial Team. Time-sensitive tax and shipping information should be confirmed with the relevant authority. LuxeMia does not present unverified customer counts, sales rankings or individual staff credentials.
